parse.title: 2026 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
parse.text:
For related races, see 2026 United States House of Representatives elections.
Not to be confused with 2026 Delaware House of Representatives election.
2026 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware's at-large district
← 2024
November 3, 2026
2028 →
 
Nominee Sarah McBride Joseph Arminio
Party Democratic Republican
Incumbent U.S. Representative

Sarah McBride
Democratic



The 2026 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of Delaware from its at-large congressional district. The election coincides with other elections to the U.S. House, elections to the United States Senate, and various other state and local elections. Primary elections took place on September 15, 2026.[1]

Incumbent Democratic representative Sarah McBride was elected in 2024 with 57.9% of the vote.[2]
